# Mohammad Moin

> Senior Full Stack Engineer, Web & Mobile Application Developer and corporate trainer with 14+ years across React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, frontend architecture and Infrastructure as Code. Based in Bengaluru, India (IST, UTC+5:30), open to remote and cross-timezone teams.

## About
Mohammad Moin works at the intersection of building and teaching. As a developer, he designs and ships production web and mobile applications end to end — architecture through deployment. As a freelance corporate trainer, he designs practical engineering upskilling programs for corporate teams.

## Core engineering focus
- Angular — enterprise application architecture, Signals, RxJS, routing, state, performance, testing and Nx
- React — React 19, component architecture, hooks, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Vite, performance and testing
- React Native — cross-platform mobile architecture, Expo, navigation, Reanimated, device debugging and production delivery
- Frontend Architecture — application boundaries, design systems, Nx monorepos, microfrontends, Module Federation, state and delivery architecture
- Terraform & Azure — Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, state management, CI/CD, GitHub Actions and infrastructure security

## Development
- Frontend & Mobile: React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, SolidJS, React Native, TypeScript, Ionic
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, NestJS, Express, GraphQL
- Architecture & Tooling: Nx, monorepos, microfrontends, Module Federation, design systems, Vite
- Infra & Delivery: Terraform, Azure, AWS, Firebase, Docker, GitHub Actions

## Recent engagement
React Consultant, JLL (Jan 2024 – Mar 2025): re-architected legacy AEM/Java-based web components to React within a 10–15 engineer team spanning multiple countries; orchestrated a shared design system built in SolidJS, translated into React and Angular.

## Selected projects
- AquaTrack — water consumption and billing platform deployed for a residential society (React, TypeScript, Firebase)
- Freelance Billing & Taxation Tool — independent invoicing/billing system handling Indian GST and statutory compliance
- Giftiicon — e-commerce gifting app (React Native, Node.js)

## Training
- Practical corporate technology training across Angular, React, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript and Nx
- Enterprise engineering upskilling, stack migration and custom curriculum design
- Enterprise clients: IBM, Amazon, Walmart, SAP, Dell — cohorts of 20–50 engineers, with repeat engagements from returning clients
